meta.title: Create and publish a Price Based auction
gaps: Assert that the published event's live page shows the Price Based auction strategy.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Assert that the published event's live page shows the Price Based auction strategy.

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen required for auction strategy selection.
Select Auction, the Price Based strategy, and a valid awarding rule.
Verify the selected strategy is shown in the configuration screen.
Apply the auction pricing template before adding line items.
Add the required auction line item.
Complete the pricing sheet for the line item.
Commit a valid event schedule before publishing.
Publish the configured Price Based auction.
Assert that the event was successfully published to a real project page.
